newsitem.title: UK: Gazprom insures gas supplies to West at Lloyd's.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom insures gas supplies to West at Lloyd's.

text.p: RAO Gazprom, the world's largest natural gas producer, has secured an insurance policy to help cushion it against the cost of supplies to the West being stopped by technical failure.
Gazprom, Russia's largest company, secured the deal with insurance syndicates at Lloyd's of London through its adviser and insurer Riceman Insurance Investments Plc.
A source close to Riceman said: "Gazprom is about the transportation of gas, and they need to be able to guarantee their sales to the West."
"It is not a financial guarantee, but it is a way of helping ensure gas gets from A to B on a timely basis," he said.
"Supplies can be reduced because of problems, and if it happens this insurance will be there to help, " he added.
The source insisted that the deal did not cover the costs of environmental clean-up in the event of an accident. He said the premium for the insurance deal was estimated to be appoaching $20 million.

Riceman chief executive Robert Alford said: "A great deal of effort and technical innovation has been directed at this transaction and I am delighted that Lloyd's underwriters have been able to develop an insurance product to meet Gazprom's requirements.

The insurance deal, done in conjunction with Ricemans 49 per cent owned associate Anglo-Russia Insurance Company, was placed at Lloyd's by First City, a London market insurance broker. (( --Reuters Insurance News +44 171 542 2770 ))
